evals.prompt: Find the five most relevant local Papers With Code papers about vision-language models and return structured output. Do not query the public API or write SQL.
evals.expected_output: Uses the repository-local pwc hybrid search command with --limit 5 and --json, including the required uv/environment prefix.

evals.prompt: Check whether the update_citations cron is healthy and whether its Semantic Scholar credential works. Keep this read-only and machine-readable.
evals.expected_output: Uses pwc cron health update_citations --json and pwc cron token-check PWC_SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY --json without revealing the credential.
